title: test(app-shell): pin the flow-node label at the producer, not the reader
body:
Fixes #6331

## The census, and the number first

**Six flow-node literals across five producer call sites. Every one already writes a `label`.** So this lands the fork's first arm: a producer-boundary pin plus the recorded reason the reader type stays optional. No live defect to grade as a Bug.

**Pathspec bound** — the census is not "I grepped around". Three complementary searches over the tracked tree at `7a5da1414` (`git ls-files` = 5885 files; 4692 under the source/data extensions), each carrying a hot control:

| search | bound | control (a producer I already knew sets a label) |
|---|---|---|
| typed literals: `: (FlowDesignerNode\|FlowNodeLike\|FlowNode) = {` | all tracked `*.ts,*.tsx,*.js,*.mjs,*.cjs` | found `FlowCanvas.tsx:273` `addNode` ✅ |
| every write into a `nodes` array (`nodes: [`, `.nodes.push(`, `[...nodes,`, `appendArray(nodes`, `spliceArray(nodes`) | same | found `FlowCanvas.tsx:281` + `FlowPreview.tsx:144` ✅ |
| node-type literals (`type: '<one of the 20 FLOW_BUILTIN_NODE_TYPES>'`) | same, plus `*.json,*.yml,*.yaml` (0 hits — no flow fixtures on disk) | found `apps/console/src/preview-samples.ts` ✅ |

The third search is the one that earned its keep: it surfaced `buildFlowSkeleton`, which a `head`-capped grep had hidden from me a step earlier. A zero from a truncated pipe reads exactly like a zero from a clean tree.

## The producers, and what enforces each

| # | producer | writes a label as | enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `FlowCanvas.addNode` — palette pick and the `+` append handle | `defaultNodeLabel(type, locale)` | ⚠️ **nothing — accident** |
| 2 | `FlowCanvas.insertOnEdge` — "Insert node here" | `defaultNodeLabel(type, locale)` | ⚠️ **nothing — accident** |
| 3 | `FlowCanvas.addReviseLoop` — the ADR-0044 one-click loop | `tr('engine.flowCanvas.awaitingRevision')` | ✅ `flow-canvas-seeds.spec-parse.test.tsx` clicks the real button and `safeParse`s the emitted node |
| 4 | `FlowPreview.handleAddNode` — the empty-flow seed | `defaultNodeLabel('start', locale)` | ⚠️ **nothing — accident** |
| 5 | `buildFlowSkeleton` — Studio "New flow" (mints 2 nodes) | required positional `startLabel` / `endLabel` | ✅ omitting one does not type-check, **and** `createConformance.test.ts` parses the whole draft |

Not producers, checked and excluded with the reason:

- `FlowCanvas.persistPosition`, `deleteNode`, and `flow-nested-selection.ts`'s nested writes — all **re-spread an existing node** (`{ ...node, position }`) or filter. They cannot be where a label is first written, and cannot drop one: `FlowNodeInspector.patchNode` is `{ ...node, ...updates }`.
- `anchors.ts` flow `createDefaults` — seeds `nodes: []`. No node.
- `flow-region-view.tsx` — nested regions render **read-only** ("no drag / insert"), so there is no nested-node producer.
- **Paste** — the card lists it; there is none for spec flows. The only paste producer in the repo is `ProcessDesigner`'s BPMN clipboard, and that is `BPMNNode` from `@object-ui/types` (a different shape, `label` already required there) with no path to a flow save.
- **Import** — the card lists it; there is no metadata-import surface in this repo (`0` hits).
- `apps/console/src/preview-samples.ts` — read-only gallery data, not an authoring path.

## ⭐ "They all happen to" vs "something prevents otherwise" — measured, not argued

That distinction is the whole value of the census, so it was taken as a measurement on `origin/main`, before any change here. Deleting the `label` line from `insertOnEdge` and from `FlowPreview.handleAddNode` (mutation proved on disk in both directions: anchor counts 1→0, replacement marker 0→1, and blob hashes moved) left **everything green**:

```
VITEST_EXIT=0    Test Files  3 passed (3)   Tests  58 passed (58)
TSC_EXIT=0
ESLINT_EXIT=0    ✖ 7 problems (0 errors, 7 warnings)
```

Three of five producers were held only by every current author happening to write the line. That is the finding, and it is why the pin is at the producer.

## Why not the reader type — do not re-litigate

`FlowNodeSchema` requires `label`; `FlowDesignerNode` makes it optional. That is a **layer** difference the repo already adjudicated in that interface's own doc comment — a canvas holds nodes the user has dropped but not finished. #6287 measured making it required on the reader side: `tsc` exit 0, **zero errors**, because every node arrives through `as FlowNodeLike[]` casts out of `Record<string, unknown>` and **a cast bypasses a required member**. It is also mildly harmful: `node.label ?? ''` and `node.label || node.id` are guards the optional type forces. So this PR touches **no declared type** — Clause-② stays `no`. The reasoning is now recorded on `FlowDesignerNode.label` itself, which is what stops the question being opened a third time.

## What the pin is

`flow-node-producers.label.test.tsx`, in two halves, because neither is enough alone:

1. **Observed output.** Each producer is driven through the affordance a user clicks, and the node it *emitted* is `safeParse`d whole against the spec. ⛔ Never a hand-composed node — the sibling seeds file composes `{ id, type, label: defaultNodeLabel(type), ...defaultNodeExtras(type) }` itself, which is right for *its* subject (the seed extras) and is exactly why it stayed green through the ablation above: it supplies the label, so it can never see a producer drop one.
2. **A census ratchet over source.** The render half can only speak for producers it renders. The scan enumerates node literals from source across `previews/`, `inspectors/` and `studio-design/` and refuses one that writes no label, with a hot control so a scan that matches *nothing* fails loudly instead of reading as clean. Its blind spot (an untyped literal assembled elsewhere and cast in) is stated in the file.

Two-world proof, on the committed pin, restoring by hash equality:

| mutation | before this PR | with the pin |
|---|---|---|
| `addNode` drops `label` (blob `efc46c8f`, byte-identical run) | 58/58 green, tsc 0, eslint 0 errors | **2 failed** — `FlowCanvas.addNode` + the census ratchet |
| `insertOnEdge` + `FlowPreview.handleAddNode` + `buildFlowSkeleton` drop `label` | 58/58 green | **4 failed** — all three producers by name, plus the ratchet listing 3 offenders |

## Question 3 — what the server does

⚠️ **Cited from the schema, not from a run.** No server was booted. Measured against the installed `@objectstack/spec@17.2.0` (lockfile-resolved) by probe:

```
FlowNodeSchema.safeParse({ id, type: 'start', label: 'Start' })  → success
FlowNodeSchema.safeParse({ id, type: 'start' })                  → invalid_type at path ["label"]
FlowSchema.safeParse({ …flow, nodes: [{ id, type: 'start' }] })  → invalid_type at path ["nodes", 0, "label"]
```

So a label-less node is refused at the flow level too. Two related readings, both stated so they are not mistaken for the pin's subject:

- The same schema runs **live in the client** (`clientValidation.ts` maps `flow → FlowSchema`, on both the create and edit doors), and `flow-problems.ts` maps a `nodes.<n>.…` path onto that node — so the refusal already surfaces as an on-canvas badge and a Problems-panel row while the author types.
- `FlowNodeSchema` accepts `label: ''`, and the inspector's Label field commits `patchNode({ label: v })` — so clearing it yields an empty string, never an absent key. Noted, not changed: making non-empty a rule would be a second de-facto contract this card did not ask for.

## Verification

All on the final commit `8cf0859a6`, exit codes captured before any pipe, each result quoted from the gate's own verdict line.

- Dependency closure built first (`pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`, exit 0) — the worktree had no `dist` anywhere, and an unbuilt run reads as a false red.
- vitest, root-relative, 8 paths in → **8 files reported**, so no silent wrong-package run: `Test Files 8 passed (8)` / `Tests 146 passed (146)`.
- `tsc -p packages/app-shell/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit` → exit 0. `--listFiles` confirms both changed files **are** in the checked program (1 hit each), so the green is a measurement rather than an exclusion.
- `eslint .` over the **whole** `packages/app-shell` package, unnarrowed — population read from eslint's own config via `--format json`: **1026 files, 0 errors**, 2798 pre-existing warnings, and both of this PR's files contribute **0 errors and 0 warnings**.
- Gates: `check:control-bytes` OK (5802 files) · `check:spec-symbols` 0 untriaged collisions · `check:vi-mock-specifiers` OK · `check:vi-mock-inherit` OK · `check:i18n-keys` OK · `check:phantom-deps` OK · `check-changeset-presence` OK (1 changeset, empty frontmatter — the explicit "releases nothing" exemption) · `check-changeset-no-major` OK.

Changeset carries an **empty frontmatter**: a test plus a comment, no runtime behaviour and no published type changed.
